description: This file defines numerous data transfer objects (DTOs) and request models related to master/reference data entities, such as UOM (Unit of Measure), Reporting Program, Control Device, Equation, and Status Code. It includes DTOs mapping to database tables, request payload classes for creating/updating records, and a common query parameter class for filtering master lists.

classes.name: UomMasterDto
classes.description: DTO representing a Unit of Measure master record, mapping to the 'uom_master' table.

classes.name: CreateUomMasterRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new UOM master record.

classes.name: UpdateUomMasterRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating an existing UOM master record.

classes.name: ReportingProgramMasterDto
classes.description: DTO for reporting program master record, mapping to 'reporting_program_master' table.

classes.name: CreateReportingProgramMasterRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a reporting program master record.

classes.name: UpdateReportingProgramMasterRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating a reporting program master record.

classes.name: ControlDeviceMasterDto
classes.description: DTO representing a control device master record, mapping to 'control_device_master' table.

classes.name: CreateControlDeviceMasterRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a control device master record.

classes.name: UpdateControlDeviceMasterRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating a control device master record.

classes.name: EquationMasterDto
classes.description: DTO for equation master record, mapping to 'equation_master' table.

classes.name: CreateEquationMasterRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating an equation master record.

classes.name: UpdateEquationMasterRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating an equation master record.

classes.name: QueryMasterRequest
classes.description: Common query parameters class for filtering master/reference data, including active-only filter and result limit.
